reasoning_profile: Thinking enabled; isolated fresh SDK conversation per role, same-role native reasoning/tool-message continuity, private audit only. cost_and_latency_estimate: A1 measured 6 calls and about 14.5 minutes graph wall time. A2 skips replay of old reviews; expect roughly 3-8 calls and 8-20 minutes for one author revision plus two independent reviewers, with headroom for useful data calls. USD0.2-2 is a planning estimate, not a bill or guaranteed cap. Existing anomaly ceilings stay 12 author turns/16 tool actions, 6 reviewer turns/8 tool actions each; no hidden retry/resume/fallback. Owner states funds sufficient.
